extensionDescription.message: Review what matters: filter GitHub pull request diffs with your own presets and see the real size of what you review.

panelNotLoaded.message: $1 files not loaded yet, so line counts are partial

panelAnnouncePartial.message: $1 of them haven't loaded yet, so line counts are partial.

optionsTagline.message: Review what matters. Each filter becomes a button on a pull request's changed-files page.

helpBody.message: A file is shown when its path matches Include and doesn't match Exclude. Both are JavaScript regular expressions, tested against the full path (for example src/components/Button.tsx) and not case-sensitive. An empty Include matches every path.

helpTests.message: tests and stories, as an Exclude

helpAll.message: All is always available and shows every file.

reposHint.message: Optional. Added next to the filters above, only on the matching repository.

tryHint.message: See which buttons would show a file, using what's on this page, saved or not.

tryEmpty.message: Type a file path to check it.

tryOnlyAll.message: Only $1 shows this file. No filter matches it.

shareHint.message: Send your filters to a teammate, or bring in theirs.

copyHint.message: Copies every filter on this page, saved or not.

copyFallbackHint.message: Copying isn't allowed here. Select the text and copy it yourself.

importHint.message: Paste what they copied. It replaces the filters on this page, and nothing changes until you save.

filtersEmpty.message: No filters yet. Add one and it shows up as a button on pull requests.

errorRepo.message: Use owner/name, or owner/* for every repository of an owner.

statusFixFilters.message: Some filters need fixing before you can save.

statusFixRepos.message: Check the repository names before saving.

statusSaved.message: Saved. Open pull requests pick it up right away.

statusQuota.message: Too many filters to sync. Remove a few and try again.

importedOne.message: Imported 1 filter. Review it, then save.

importedMany.message: Imported $1 filters. Review them, then save.

importEmpty.message: That text has no filters in it. Ask your teammate to copy their filters again.

importInvalid.message: That text isn't a copied set of filters. Paste exactly what $1 produced.

welcomeLead.message: Big pull requests mix the code you need to read with tests, generated files and things other people own. Focus Diff adds a bar to GitHub that shows only the files you pick, with the real count of what is left to review.

howStep1Body.message: Each filter becomes a button. A file shows up when its path matches the filter's Include pattern and doesn't match its Exclude pattern.

howStep2Body.message: On the Files changed tab, the bar shows up in the bottom-right corner, with All plus your filters.

howStep3Body.message: Only the matching files stay. The file tree, Files changed and the +/− totals update to match. All brings everything back.

previewLabel.message: Example of the bar on a pull request

recipesHint.message: Add the ones that fit how you review. They're regular filters, so you can rename or tweak them later in settings.

recipeAddedNotice.message: Added $1. Open a pull request to try it.

recipeStackDescription.message: Review the UI and the API in separate passes, without tests and stories in the way.

recipeAreaTitle.message: Focus on one part of the codebase

recipeAreaDescription.message: Only the folder your team owns. Swap payments for your own path, and add it to a single repository if it only exists there.

recipeTestsTitle.message: Read the code before the tests

recipeTestsDescription.message: Two buttons: one hides tests, stories and mocks, the other shows only the tests.

recipeGeneratedDescription.message: Hide lockfiles, snapshots, minified files and build output that nobody reads line by line.

recipeInfraDescription.message: CI workflows, Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes and YAML config, for the reviewer who owns the platform.

recipeDatabaseDescription.message: Migrations, SQL and schema files, which deserve a careful look before merging.

recipeDocsDescription.message: Markdown, text files and anything under docs/, for writers and product reviewers.

welcomeShortcuts.message: Switch filters without the mouse: $1 next, $2 previous, $3 all files.

filtersEmptyWithExamples.message: No filters yet. Add one, or start from an example.

timeHint.message: Estimated review time, at about $1 changed lines per hour
